free_text: The patient is a 70-year-old male with a rising PSA of 6.9 ng/mL and a prior biopsy-proven adenocarcinoma with a Gleason score of 4+4. MRI demonstrates a PI-RADS 5 lesion in the right paramedian apex/transition zone, classified as cT1c. The competing illness is Type 2 diabetes and coronary artery disease. Management assessment is pending clinical review regarding individual treatment benefit and patient preferences.
